title: A car crash / yet & already
subtitle: 一场车祸 / 还没与已经（现在完成时与一般过去时对比）

lead.question: 你去修车行取车，怎么用英语问「我的车修好了吗？」「你们修好了没有？」——再被反问「您没出过车祸吗？」时，能听出那句否定疑问里的惊讶吗？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。上一课学了现在完成时的疑问与否定，这一课把它放进真实场景：Have your mechanics finished yet?（你们的机械师完工了吗？）——yet 是完成时疑问句和否定句的老搭档，意思是「还（没）」。而交代「三天前送来的」「撞到了电线杆上」这些过去细节时，要退回一般过去时：I brought it here three days ago. / I drove it into a lamp-post. 再留意两处神来之笔：Isn't that your car?（否定疑问表惊讶）和 Well, it was my car.（重读 was：曾经是我的车！）
goals: 掌握 yet 在现在完成时疑问句/否定句中的用法：Have ... finished yet? / They haven't finished yet.
掌握 already 在肯定句中的用法：has already met / left / found
能对比完成时（问结果）与一般过去时（给时间）：Has she found her pen yet? — She found it an hour ago.
掌握否定疑问句表惊讶、期待肯定回答：Isn't that your car? / Didn't you have a crash?
记住不规则动词：bring→brought, drive→drove, send→sent, tell→told, sweep→swept
lead.summary: 第 87 课伍德先生到修车行取车：车是三天前送来的，可机械师还没修好——他们还在修呢。到车库一看，服务台问：这难道不是您的车吗？伍德先生苦笑：唔，这曾是我的车——他把车撞到电线杆上了。机械师正设法修，但说实在的，您需要一辆新车了。第 88 课系统操练：过去时疑问句改否定句，以及 Has ... yet? / has already ... / When did ...? 的三连问。
lead.tips: ① yet（还、已经）用于疑问句和否定句；already（已经）用于肯定句；② yet 问「完成了吗」，否定回答 Haven't finished yet. 还没完成；③ ago（……以前）短语是一般过去时的标志，动词必须用过去式；④ work on it 的 on 表示「从事于、修理」；⑤ to tell you the truth 说实在的；⑥ 否定疑问句 Isn't that your car? 表示惊讶并期待肯定回答。

questions.q: Can the mechanics repair Mr Wood's car?
questions.zh: 修理工能修复伍德先生的汽车吗？
questions.a: They're trying to repair it, but to tell you the truth, he needs a new car.
questions.aZh: 他们正设法修，不过说实在的，他需要一辆新车了。

questions.q: When did Mr Wood bring his car to the garage?
questions.zh: 伍德先生什么时候把车送来的？
questions.a: He brought it here three days ago.
questions.hint: I brought it here ... 一句。

questions.q: What's the licence number of Mr Wood's car?
questions.zh: 伍德先生汽车的牌照号码是多少？

questions.q: Why is the car so badly damaged?
questions.zh: 车为什么损毁得这么厉害？
questions.a: Because Mr Wood had a crash — he drove it into a lamp-post.
questions.aZh: 因为伍德先生出了车祸——他把车撞到了电线杆上。
questions.hint: Didn't you have a crash? 之后的回答。

questions.q: Why does the attendant ask 'Isn't that your car?' instead of 'Is that your car?'
questions.zh: 服务台为什么问 Isn't that your car? 而不是 Is that your car?？
questions.a: A negative yes/no question expresses surprise or expectation of a positive answer — the attendant can hardly believe the sight. 'Well, it was my car.' (stressed was) means it used to be his car before the crash.
questions.aZh: 否定疑问句表示惊讶、期待得到肯定回答——服务台几乎不敢相信眼前的景象。Well, it was my car.（重读 was）意为「这曾经是我的车（撞坏之后就不像了）」。
questions.hint: 想想中文「这难道不是您的车吗？」的语气。

questions.q: Has he met Mrs. Jones yet? — Yes, he has already met Mrs. Jones. When did he meet Mrs. Jones? — He met her two weeks ago.
questions.zh: 第 88 课 B 组操练：Has ... yet? — Yes, ... has already .... When did ...? — ... ago/昨天等。
questions.a: Has she told him the truth yet? — Yes, she has already told him the truth. She told him the truth last night.
questions.aZh: 她把真相告诉他了吗？——已经告诉他了。什么时候说的？——昨晚说的。
questions.hint: yet 问 → already 答 → 过去时补时间，三步走。

text.title: yet & already（完成时与过去时操练）

drill.q: A 组：Did he/she/you ___ ...? → He/She/We didn't ___ ....；B 组：Has he/she ___ yet? — Yes, he/she has already ___. When did he/she ___? — He/She ___ ... ago / last night.
drill.zh: 第 88 课操练：A 组把过去时疑问句改为否定句；B 组用 yet 问、already 答、再用一般过去时补上具体时间。

slots.en: find his pen — a minute ago
slots.zh: 找到钢笔 — 一分钟前

slots.en: get a new television — last week
slots.zh: 买新电视机 — 上星期

slots.en: hear the news — on the radio
slots.zh: 听到消息 — 通过收音机

slots.en: meet Mrs. Jones — two weeks ago
slots.zh: 见到琼斯太太 — 两周前

slots.en: the boss leave — ten minutes ago
slots.zh: 老板离开 — 十分钟前

slots.en: find her pen — an hour ago
slots.zh: 找到钢笔 — 一小时前
整理床铺 — 今天早晨

slots.en: send the letter — the day before yesterday
tell him the truth — last night

answers: Did he find his pen a minute ago? He didn't find his pen a minute ago.
Did you sweep the floor this morning? I didn't sweep the floor this morning.
Has he met Mrs. Jones yet? Yes, he has already met Mrs. Jones. When did he meet Mrs. Jones? He met her two weeks ago.
Has the boss left yet? Yes, the boss has already left. He left ten minutes ago.
Has she told him the truth yet? Yes, she has already told him the truth. She told him the truth last night.

exercises.q: 改否定句：He found his pen a minute ago.
exercises.a: He didn't find his pen a minute ago.
exercises.note: 一般过去时否定借助 didn't + 动词原形。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我的汽车修好了吗？
exercises.note: yet 用于疑问句，问「（到现在）已经……了吗」。
work on 从事于（修理）；still 仍然。

exercises.q: Has she told him the truth yet? 的回答（昨晚已告诉）。
exercises.a: Yes, she has already told him the truth. She told him the truth last night.
exercises.note: already 答完成时；last night 点明时间换过去时 told。

exercises.note: to tell you the truth 是口语插入语。

exercises.q: 改一般疑问句：We heard the news on the radio.
exercises.a: Did you hear the news on the radio?
exercises.note: 过去时疑问借助 did + 动词原形。

options: 用于疑问句和否定句，意为「还（没）」
意为「已经」，只用于肯定句
quiz.note: yet 与完成时疑问句、否定句连用；肯定句中的「已经」用 already。

quiz.q: — Have your mechanics finished yet? — 还没修好：
quiz.note: 否定句配 yet：haven't finished yet；already 不用于否定。

quiz.q: I brought it here three days ago. 中为什么用 brought？
options: ago 短语是明确过去时间，用一般过去时
quiz.note: three days ago 指明过去时间，动词用过去式。

quiz.q: Isn't that your car? 的语气是：
options: 表示惊讶，期待对方肯定回答
quiz.note: 否定疑问句常用来表示惊讶或期待肯定答复。

quiz.q: Didn't you have a crash? 的回答「是啊」应说：
quiz.note: 对否定疑问句的肯定回答回答事实本身：That's right.（确实出过）。

quiz.q: Well, it was my car. 中重读 was 强调：
options: 车曾经是我的（现在撞坏了）
quiz.note: was 斜体/重读表示对过去的强调：以前是我的车。

grammar.title: 现在完成时的疑问式及否定式（+ yet）
grammar.structure: 疑问：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词 ... yet?；否定：主语 + haven't/hasn't + 过去分词 ... yet
grammar.definition: 现在完成时由 have/has + 过去分词构成；疑问式把 have/has 提到主语前，否定式在其后加 not。yet（还、已经）是完成时疑问句和否定句的常用副词。
grammar.usage: 问结果是否完成：Have your mechanics finished yet? — No, they haven't finished yet.

examples.en: Have your mechanics finished yet?
examples.zh: 你们的机械师修好了吗？

examples.en: Is my car ready yet?
examples.zh: 我的汽车修好了吗？

grammar.title: 一般过去时与现在完成时的对比
grammar.structure: 过去时：动词过去式 + ago/last ... 等明确时间；完成时：have/has + 过去分词 + yet/already
grammar.definition: 问「做完了吗」用完成时；回答「什么时候做的」这类具体过去时间，必须改用一般过去时。already（已经）用于肯定句，yet 用于疑问句和否定句。
grammar.usage: Has she found her pen yet? — Yes, she has already found it. She found it an hour ago.

examples.en: When did you bring it to us? — I brought it here three days ago.
examples.zh: 您什么时候送来的？——3 天前送来的。

examples.en: Yes, she has already told him the truth.
examples.zh: 是的，她已经把真相告诉他了。

grammar.title: 否定疑问句表示惊讶
grammar.structure: Isn't that ...? / Didn't you ...?（一般疑问句的否定形式）
grammar.definition: 一般疑问句的否定形式用来表示惊异、责难或期待、请求得到肯定回答，相当于汉语的「难道不……吗？」。回答时按事实回答：肯定事实用 Yes, ... did/have。
grammar.usage: Isn't that your car? / Didn't you have a crash? — That's right.
